column1: # Tab-separated, "-" = empty (tabs collapse in bash `read`, so a bare empty field would shift columns).
#   backends     comma list of backends its build.sh accepts (HIP is UNTESTED everywhere: no ROCm)
#   timeout_s    default hard limit for a clean run; the profiled run gets 3x
#   fom_*        the metric the application prints itself; "-" in all five when it prints none.
#                fom_regex: python regex with exactly one capture group on run.sh's stdout, the
#                LAST match wins; a case may override it (level3_cases.tsv)
#   extra_env    input variables a case may set beyond those run.sh and level3/tools/l3_common.sh
#   nvtx_roi     the NVTX range the application ITSELF emits around its time-step loop; the
#                profiled run's device activity is clipped to it. "-" = none: the device picture is
#   profile      "yes": one profiled run by default (the Level 3 protocol); "no (<reason>)": the
#                application is NOT profiled by default and its records carry the reason as a caveat;
# There are no ROI markers in Level 3: the timed region of every application is its own timer,
# defined with source citations in tools/timing/apptimers.py (`apptimers.py describe`).
